data: You summon forth a meteor shower that rains down onto the battlefield. All creatures in a 10-foot-radius circle, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a hit, or half as much on a save. After activating this move, your next attack is rolled at disadvantage. If that attack requires a saving throw, the target has advantage.
A very appealing move, but after using this move, the user is more easily startled.
Pokemon has disadvantage on all CHA Saving Throws for the remainder of the Appeal Rounds.
